stops.name: Serra de Tramuntana
stops.detail: The Serra de Tramuntana (Balearic Catalan: [ˈsɛrə ðə tɾəmunˈtanə]) is a mountain range running southwest–northeast which forms the northern backbone of the Spanish island of Mallorca. It is also the name given to the comarca of the same area. On 27 June [dated source], the Tramuntana Range was awarded World Heritage Status by UNESCO as an area of great physical and cultural significance.
